item.description:
Rainier
国内这么多模型厂确实不合理，肯定会合并到3家以内。这样卡也不用太分散，减少内耗。 而且一般行业内就前三能活下来。

deepseek是口袋很深，实力最强的，肯定有一张门票。

字节，有现金流，口袋最深，视频方向断崖领先，而且估计能盈利，飞轮转起来了。而且有耐心。豆包有市占率。肯定有一张门票。

第三章门票，就看是zhipu，还是kimi，ali拿了。

本来，ali的票是稳的。
最近阿里内讧，人员大规模流失，qwen4难产挺可惜的。qwen 在小模型这个生态本来是统治级的存在。变现途径有很多。
可惜了。

我怎么觉得接下来最难的是国内的二线基模厂呢？

一方面蒸馏被限制，中美模型性能差距进一步拉大

另一方面国内智谱minimax跌跌不休，往上天花板又被Ant锁死

我怀疑明年是不少基模厂生死存亡的一年 - 3x Long JD(美股版）
tweet

item.title: Avi Chawla Vibe coding has a new problem now: Employees are building internal to
item.description:
Avi Chawla
Vibe coding has a new problem now:

Employees are building internal tools with AI app builders, and many of those tools are open to anyone who finds the link.

Earlier this year, RedAccess found about 5,000 apps made with popular AI app builders exposing company data to anyone who found them, including a Brazilian bank's internal financials.

When an agent does add an access check, it writes it inside the app it's building. Do that across ten tools and three agents, and you get ten versions of the same rule that nobody can see all at once.

A better model doesn't fix this. Even a perfect check is still stuck inside one app, and the next app needs its own.

So I gave Claude Code, Codex and Cursor the same prompt to build an internal tool, a table of employee salaries from one Postgres database.

I told all three to leave access out of the code, so every salary was visible to whoever opened the apps.

All three run on @retool, a platform for running AI-built internal apps in production, and read the database through one Retool connection. So I set access once, on that connection, with Retool's Data Access Enforcement.

→ HR sees all 15 employees in every app
→ An Engineering Manager sees only the 5 on his team

I didn't change a line of code in any app. Retool adds the row filter where it connects to the database, so only the allowed rows ever come back.

The video below shows the builds, the policy and both logins side by side, and I worked with the team to put this together.

Agents can build the tools on their own now. Build wherever you're fastest, and run it on Retool, where access is set once for every app.

Try it yourself here: https://t.co/govcnCeYo0

If you want to dive deeper, I wrote an article that covers everything you need to understand about what stands between AI-built apps and the data they read, and how to keep it the same no matter which agent wrote the code.

Read it below.

https://t.co/UAATCg2LQo - Avi Chawla
tweet

item.description:
Thariq
I've joined OpenAI!

I'm very proud of my time at Anthropic, and I'll continue to root for my former colleagues. Both companies have important roles to play in the future.

There is a tremendous amount of work ahead of us to bring AI to the world, and it will demand the very best of all of us. I felt that I could personally contribute the most to this effort at OpenAI.

I believe this is one of the great strengths of Silicon Valley, the flow of ideas and people.

I'm excited to join a team I've long admired, building incredible AI products for over a billion people, and to work alongside friends like @_catwu, @thsottiaux, @ajambrosino, @sharifshameem, @jxnlco and many others to push the frontier forward.

More than anything, I hope to make your experience of using AI just a little bit better.

I am once again at your service.

Thariq

item.description:
一亩三分地 - 海外求职热门帖子
腾讯北美职位

帮朋友发他们的招人信息：https://tencent.wd1.myworkdayjobs.com/Tencent_Careers/job/US-California-Palo-Alto/Cyber-Security-Engineer-Intern_R108141-2

这个职位是腾讯海外IT团队（Tencent Overseas IT）在加州帕洛阿尔托（Palo Alto）招收的 Cyber Security Engineer Intern（网络安全工程师实习生），实习期结束可转正。
以下是该职位的核心内容总结：

1. 主要职责与工作方向 实习生将加入海外IT的安全团队，主要参与工程投资组合中的相关项目，方向包括：
SaaS 平台与身份管理： 支持 SaaS 平台的运营与安全，参与身份和访问管理（IAM）系统、用户认证及授权解决方案。
DevOps、SRE 与可观测性： 贡献部署管道和系统可靠性，处理监控、日志和警报系统，开发自动化与运维工具，并支持事件响应与故障排查。
安全运维与数据管道： 参与安全运维和威胁监控，开发数据摄取、处理或分析系统，处理大规模数据存储、查询和实时数据流。

1. 基本任职要求 教育背景： 计算机科学、计算机工程或相关领域的学士学位（偏好应届毕业生）。
核心工程技能： 熟练掌握至少一门编程语言（如 Python、Go、Java、C++ 等），熟悉 Linux/Unix 命令行与 Shell 脚本，具备基础的数据结构、算法和系统设计概念，能够阅读代码和排查问题。
基础设施与系统： 对分布式系统、微服务、容器化（Docker）及虚拟化有基本理解，掌握网络基础知识（TCP/IP、DNS、HTTP/HTTPS）。
软技能： 具备良好的解决问题能力、系统性排查能力，沟通良好，具备团队合作精神和学习热情。

1. 加分项（优先条件） 熟悉网络协议、负载均衡、服务网格或分布式追踪。
具备 AWS、GCP 或 Azure 等云服务的使用经验。
熟悉 Docker、Kubernetes 等容器与编排技术。
有数据库、数据管道、消息队列或流处理的使用经验。
有基础设施安全、身份访问管理或安全工具的接触经验。

1. 薪资待遇 薪资范围： 每小时 $27.12 至 $51.93（具体薪资取决于相关知识、技能和经验）。

软技能： 具备良好的解决问题能力、系统性排查能力，沟通良好，具备团队合作精神和学习热情。
